blocks.html: This research challenge explores three key questions:

• How can AI technologies improve documentation and related efforts for Brazilian indigenous languages?
  • How should current tools be adapted to work with low-resource and endangered languages?
  • How can AI tools be developed for indigenous communities in an ethical way?
The team empowers indigenous communities with AI, ethically collaborates with São Paulo’s indigenous groups, investigating Guarani Mbya language and developing student support tools.

overview.title: Strengthening Brazilian Indigenous Languages with AI
overview.summary: Collaborative research into the development of artificial intelligence technologies to support the documentation and strengthening of Brazilian Indigenous languages.
focusAreas: AI tools for languages with few digital resources.
Ethical development of technologies in collaboration with Indigenous communities.
